title: 4-IN-1 Detachable Cosmetic Bag, Foldable Waterproof PU Leather Makeup Bag, Portable Travel Toiletry Organizer Bag for Women Daily & Travel Use (Premium Gray)
details: 4-IN-1 Detachable Compartments Design: Features 4 independent zippered pockets to neatly organize skincare, cosmetics, makeup brushes and small accessories, eliminating messy searching. Each pouch is detachable for separate use, perfect for on-the-go convenience.

Foldable & Space-Saving Travel Design: Expands into a desktop organizer for easy access to all products, and folds into a compact carry bag for ultra-portability. Ideal for business trips, vacations, weekend getaways and daily use.

Premium Waterproof PU Material: Made of high-quality textured PU leather that is waterproof, stain-resistant and scratch-proof, easy to clean with a simple wipe. The smooth finish delivers a luxurious look for your travel essentials.
Large Capacity & Compact Structure: Generously holds full-size toiletries, lotions, serums, makeup palettes, brushes, sunglasses and more, all in one bag without adding extra bulk to your luggage.

Versatile for Daily & Travel Use: Doubles as a cosmetic bag, toiletry pouch, makeup case and desktop organizer. A stylish and practical storage solution for women who value order, elegance and functionality.
